description: Inspect current staged, unstaged and non-ignored untracked changes and return a snapshot-bound affected-test plan and fallback reasons. Runs no tests; a plan is not a passing receipt. With scope "staged" or "paths", plans HEAD plus only the index or only the given files in a temporary worktree, and returns the one `diffci verify --staged`/`--paths` command to run; use it before a commit when other sessions share the checkout.

repo.description: Absolute repository path; defaults to server working directory. Always pass the edited repository when using a plugin.

scope.description: working-tree (default): every uncommitted change. staged: HEAD plus the index only. paths: HEAD plus only `paths`.

name: diffci_select_tests
